phases.label: Pre-application
phases.desc: Prerequisite approvals needed before a Factory License application can even be filed (e.g. building/factory plan approval).

phases.label: Application
phases.desc: Registering on the portal, filling the form, and submitting required documents.

phases.label: Fee payment
phases.desc: Paying the prescribed license fee, usually online.

phases.label: Scrutiny
phases.desc: Document/compliance checking, deficiency and query handling, inter-departmental routing.

phases.label: Inspection
phases.desc: Physical site inspection by a factory/safety inspector.

phases.label: Approval & certificate
phases.desc: Final decision and issuance of the signed Factory License certificate.

phases.label: Renewal
phases.desc: What happens after the first license — annual or periodic renewal requirements.

note: Every state's ED-derived step list already tags each step with one of these 7 phase codes (confirmed by inspecting server/db/seed-data.json across all 11 states) — this is a real, consistently-applied taxonomy already in the data, not a new invention. Use it as the backbone for the Stage Comparison view: for each phase, show every state's actual sub-steps, automation level, and the tagged findings/gaps whose topic tags relate to that phase (e.g. tag INSPECT -> phase inspect, tag FEES -> phase fee, tag QUERY/INTERDEP -> phase scrutiny).
